coverage.name: Cheyenne County
limitations: Read 2026-10-10: the Cheyenne County Clerk and Recorder page now posts "2026 General Election Sample Ballot - All Precincts" (text-readable PDF, 2 pages, a single ballot style 001-01). Its only questions are the statewide amendments and propositions and the judicial retention questions; it has no county, municipal, school or special district ballot question.
No TABOR notice and no list of participating political subdivisions was posted on the county clerk page checked on 2026-10-10.
